subject: semTools error: "Error: inherits(lavobject, "lavaan") is not TRUE"

messages.author: 5c527df876dd0445
messages.subject: semTools error: "Error: inherits(lavobject, "lavaan") is not TRUE"
parts:
Hi all,

I am using cfa.mi to fit a model through 50 "complete" datasets externally imputed using mice -- I imputed data using mice, loaded the "complete" dataset into a list, and use this list in the argument cfa.mi("data=")

When I analyze each dataset separately using cfa() everything goes as expected. However, when I try to run a model using the list in the "data=" argument using cfa.mi() (all commands are otherwise kept the same) I receive the following message:

Error: inherits(lavobject, "lavaan") is not TRUE


I wonder what may be causing it when I analyze all the datasets at once as a list containing 50 datasets.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: semTools error: "Error: inherits(lavobject, "lavaan") is not TRUE"
parts:
On 12/26/2016 05:54 AM, Fabrício Fialho wrote:
> Hi Yves,
>
> Please find the data I was analyzing when this message popped up. I also
> attached a copy of the command script.
>
> It seems the problem is related to the command
> "control=list(init_nelder_mead=TRUE)". If you run the script on this
> data, test1 works fine; test2 does not.

Indeed. The culprit is data[[4]]. Try:


lavaan(model=model1,
data=data[[4]],
group="group",
group.label=c("g1","g2"),
estimator="ULSMV",
parameterization="theta",
mimic="lavaan",
#Identification constraints
int.ov.free=FALSE,
int.lv.free=FALSE,
auto.fix.first=FALSE,
std.lv=FALSE,
orthogonal=TRUE,
auto.fix.single=TRUE,
auto.th=TRUE,
auto.delta=TRUE,
auto.var=TRUE,
auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE,
auto.cov.y=TRUE,
#Computational checks
zero.cell.warn=TRUE,
check=c("start","post"),
control=list(init_nelder_mead=TRUE),
verbose=TRUE)


which breaks with

Error in if (fx < 0) fx <- 0 : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

which means that the optimizer has driven the solution to a place where
the objective function returns NA.

For some reason, the melder mead algorithm gets lost for this datasets.
As a result, within runMI(), this run gets not fit of object 'lavaan'
(but NULL), hence the error message.

Solution: either remove or replace data[[4]]

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: semTools error: "Error: inherits(lavobject, "lavaan") is not TRUE"
parts: Solution: either remove or replace data[[4]]

or install the development version of lavaan (0.5-23.1047):

 install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type = "source")

where the error is avoided.

Yves.
